stance_basis: calls the draft a 'good beginning' but raises concerns about enforcement against ORV law-breakers
summary: Scott M. Bahley of Midland, Michigan wrote a letter supporting the draft environmental statement's direction of returning sylvan areas to non-motorized users, calling it 'a good beginning.' However, he expressed concern that the crux of the matter lies in enforcement and prosecution of law-breakers, citing threats posed by snowmobiles and motorcycle 'gangs' monopolizing remote trails. His support is thus conditional on effective enforcement mechanisms being in place.
complaint_summary: Bahley supports the draft statement as a good beginning for returning sylvan areas to non-motorized users but argues that enforcement and prosecution of ORV law-breakers is the crux of the matter, citing dangers posed by snowmobiles and motorcycle gangs on remote trails.
